audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed with their own why text — whys[3] literally says 'this is your peak lane window' under a stored Cho'Gath, and whys[1], whys[2], whys[5] and whys[6] all describe you winning under stored Skill or Cho'Gath rows.
audit.why: The packet chart is Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Cho'Gath/Lillia/Lillia, and the mirror already committed that exact chart on Cho'Gath's page with ratings 3,3,3,3,6,3,3 — the inverse of what I am proposing here. Leaving mine as it stood would make the two pages contradict on five stages.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs; ratings set to 7 everywhere except Level 6 at 4, which is the exact inverse of the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer sold Level 6 as your spike and first item as his; both are backwards.
audit.why: Level 6 is his only stage — Rupture into Feral Scream silences a champion whose defence is casting Blooming Blows for move speed, and Feast (80s at rank 1) is true damage that ignores resistances entirely. First item is yours, because Liandry's plus the natively max-health Dream Dust burn is what eats a Feast-stacked health bar.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the Rupture-into-silence chain; phases[5].why and phases[6].why state your item window and the convert-now deadline.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream's silence is the ability that actually beats you and it appears nowhere in the full layer, which tracks only Rupture.
audit.why: Lillia's kite IS her abilities — Blooming Blows' passive stacking move speed only exists while she is casting. A 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s cone silence turns that off. Rupture on its own is a flat 6s telegraphed crack you sidestep. NOTE: Rupture carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support, and Lillia owns no dash anyway, so I made no grounding claim — the same call the mirror made.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream and its 11s named in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: zero cooldown-sequencing cues, and dosFull[2].d called Rupture a fifteen-second cooldown.
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6 seconds at every rank — advising a player to punish a fifteen-second window that does not exist gets them knocked up.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in: Rupture 6s, Feral Scream 11s, in three places.

notes: Chart now matches the mirror exactly (Cho'Gath's page has 3,3,3,3,6,3,3; mine is the inverse 7,7,7,7,4,7,7) so mirror-fix has nothing to overwrite. The packet flags the chart as contradicting a 42.86% win rate over 7 games — 7 games is noise and the corrected chart is the one both pages already agree on, so I did not bend the chart to the record. The unstated fact worth the most here is that Feral Scream's silence, not Rupture's knockup, is what actually kills you: Blooming Blows' stacking move speed only exists while you are casting, so a silence removes your only defence. Rupture's derived 'grounding' flag contradicts Riot's text and Lillia has no dash regardless — no grounding claim made. focus.text is 'Cho'Gath Rupture (Knockup)' with a parenthetical that is not part of the name; I left it because the whole page keys off that exact string and a rename needs all of them changed together.
